headline: Short ZEC at 1,152.35 sits only 20.5 (1.1x the 1h ATR of 18.4) above the 24h low 1,131.83, after a -5.33% drop, with momentum turning up on all three timeframes and bids 1.56x asks.
argument:
The downtrend is real (1h EMA9 1151.95 < EMA21 1165.07, price under SMA50 1203.73 and SMA200 1247.53), but the move has already been paid for. Price is down 5.33% in 24h and sits 20.5 above the 24h low of 1131.83, which is just 1.1x the 1h ATR (18.4). A short entered here has almost no room before the first support.

Momentum is turning against a short, not with it. The MACD histogram is positive and rising on 5m (0.378 vs 0.301), 15m (1.3515 vs 1.1581) and 1h (1.6006 vs 0.9369). 5m RSI is 59.8, EMA9 is above EMA21 on 5m and 15m, and price is above the UTC-day VWAP (1151.38). The top-100 book is bid-heavy: bids 590,536 vs asks 378,102 USDT (ratio 1.56). A bounce toward 1165 (1h EMA21) or 1179 (15m 50-bar high) is the more likely next leg, and a stop above those levels costs 13 to 27 points.

Volume is thin: 5m 0.35x, 15m 0.53x, 1h 0.24x of the 20-bar average. Thin tape after a flush favors squeezes. Fear and Greed is 32 (Fear), up from 29, so sentiment is already washed out. The bearish ETF-outflow narrative is not new: FXStreet and TMGM have run it since early October, so it is priced in. The reward-to-risk is poor and the entry is in the middle of the range.
